Built for services with different lengths and prices

A cut, a colour and a blow-dry are different events. Cal.com gives each its own duration, price, buffer and questions, per stylist.

Set up scheduling links per service, with processing time as a buffer and a deposit through Stripe. Every stylist has their own page under the salon's team page; clients can choose a person or take the first available. A follow-up workflow sends a rebooking link six weeks later.
